verses.gurmukhi: ਸਮਸਰਿ ਵਰਸੈ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਿਉ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: samasar varasai savaiaa(n)t boo(n)dh jiau sabhanee thaiee|

en.bdb: As the drops of rain in the svati nakstr (fifteenth star formation among the) twenty seven star formations known in india) fall equally at all places,

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਧਰਤੀ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: jal a(n)dhar jal hoi milai dharatee bahu bhaiee|

en.bdb: And falling into water they merge in water and on earth they become earth;

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਖ ਬਿਰਖ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਘਣੇ ਫਲੁ ਫੁਲੁ ਸੁਹਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: kirakh birakh ras kas ghane fal ful suhaiee|

en.bdb: At places it transforms into plants and vegetation, sweet and bitter; at some places they are well adorned with myriad flowers and fruits.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਲੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਪੂਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: kele vich kapoor hoi seetal sukhadhaiee|

en.bdb: Falling on the banana leaves they transform into cooling camphor.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੋਤੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਿਪ ਮੁਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਮੋਲ ਮੁਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: motee hovai sip muh bahu mol mulaiee|

en.bdb: The same when they fall into a sea-shell become pearls.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਦੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲਕੂਟ ਚਿਤਵੇ ਬੁਰਿਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: biseear dhe muh kaalakooT chitave buriaaiee|

en.bdb: Gone into the mouth of a snake they turn into deadly poison and always think evil.
The Lord prevades all places and sits in state in the holy congregation.
